messages:
Elaine (CS): Quick async — MarlinPay renewal call at 2pm PT. They reported degraded search relevance and intermittent 5xx errors from embeddings since last deploy (embed-lite v1.9). What I did: triaged logs, opened an incident in Statusboard, alerted Eng. Blocker: can't confirm whether root cause is model change vs batching change; customer needs ETA for the call. Today: need eng triage and mitigation (rollback or pin their org to v1.8).

Kevin (Infra): Looking at host metrics. I see a spike in OOM-like errors on embed-pool-ed-12 around the deploy time. 502/500s correlate with large batched requests (batch_size 32). Can you share a sample request id?

Elaine (CS): Sample req id: req_marlin_20260301_4829. Example curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v1.9","input":["<payload...>"]}'```

Tom (Eng): On it. I can repro a spike locally with large batches on the quantized worker image. Short-term we can limit max_batch_size to 8 for that pool or pin MarlinPay org to embed-lite-v1.8. Which do you want to prefer for the call? /cc @Rahul

Rahul (ML): Not seeing a semantic regression in embeddings dims/values, so this looks runtime/memory. The quantized attention kernel in v1.9 is using slightly more workspace for long payloads. I'll push a runtime cap on max_seq_for_embeddings and a hotfix to cap per-request memory; ETA ~30m to rollout to the affected pool.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Rahul to pool embed-pool-ed-12 in 10m (CID: deploy-8743).

Sara (CS Manager): Noted — renewal in 2pm. If ETA >30m we'll ask for a rollback to avoid derailing the call. Linda, please prep the customer-facing note.

Linda (Support): Draft ready. Will send this: "We are investigating intermittent embedding errors after a recent deployment. Our engineering team is rolling a hotfix and we will update in the next 30-45 minutes. Temporary mitigation: we can pin your org to embed-lite-v1.8 if you'd prefer immediate stability."

Kevin (Infra): Hotfix rollout started. Restarting embed-pool-ed-12 nodes now. Early signals: 5xx rate for org-marlinpay down from ~5.8% -> ~0.9% after first node. Monitoring dashboards show CPU/mem trend normalizing.

Tom (Eng): Thanks. Can someone confirm if MarlinPay is okay with a short window of degraded results during call, or prefer rollback? Elaine, what do they want?

Elaine (CS): They're in the meeting now; asked for assurance they'll have stable behavior. I told them fix is rolling and we can do immediate pin to v1.8 if errors persist. I'll update here after the call. :thumbsup:

Rahul (ML): Rollout completed to pool-ed-12. Post-rollout 5xx is ~0.4% and tracebacks gone. Filed INF-5321 to track follow-up (kernel workspace tuning + add regression tests for quantized builds). I'll downgrade priority to P1 after 2h of stable metrics.

Kevin (Infra): Confirming tail errors settled. Recommend keeping throttled max_batch_size=8 for 24h for that pool as a conservative measure.

Elaine (CS): Great — I'll tell MarlinPay the issue is mitigated and that eng will follow up with a detailed postmortem and timeline for a permanent fix. Thanks everyone!
